name: Plugin evals folders contain scenarios
instruction: Every plugins/<plugin>/evals/ folder contains at least one scenario folder with a task.md file.
relevant_when: The supplied paths include at least one file under a plugins/<plugin>/evals/ folder.
context: An evals folder without task.md scenarios passes tessl eval lint as "0 scenarios valid" and silently gives the plugin no eval coverage.
scope_reason: Whether each evals folder holds a task.md is visible from the file paths alone.

checklist.name: each-evals-folder-has-task
checklist.rule: For every distinct plugins/<plugin>/evals/ prefix among the supplied paths, at least one path matches plugins/<plugin>/evals/<scenario>/task.md. Not applicable when no supplied path is under an evals folder.
